title: SEVENZ: Realistic MC
description:
a modpack that makes minecraft. look so real!


NOTE: by default the name of the instance is "e" THAT IS NORMAL
body:
SEVENZ: Realistic Minecraft is a mythos-driven survival modpack built for Forge 1.20.1. It blends trauma mechanics, immersive sound design, family simulation, and lore-coded UI to deliver a gritty, pain-core experience. You’ll collapse, bleed, emote, and beg for mercy—while navigating a world where every injury, scream, and betrayal leaves a mark.

🔥 Core Features
Limb-Specific Trauma: First Aid introduces localized damage—break your leg, lose mobility. No healing potions here.

Ballistics & Bleeding: XBullet and Gore and More add projectile realism and blood effects. Pair with emotes for agony immersion.

Survival Stressors: Tough As Nails brings thirst, temperature, and environmental pressure.

Agony Mechanics: Yank It Out is a custom mercy mod—rip the pain, save the soul.

Physics & Collapse: RealisticPhysics, Prototype Physics, and Corpse Mod simulate ragdoll falls, body persistence, and lootable corpses.

Immersive Soundscape: Sound Physics Remastered adds echoes and muffling. EmoteCraft and playerAnimator let you scream, collapse, and emote with WAV triggers.

Voice Communication: VoiceChat and VoiceChatRecording support real-time agony and lore-coded dialogue.

UI & Lore Integration: FancyMenus, GlitchCore, and RPG-HUD deliver trauma overlays, subtitle-tagged splash screens, and immersive status bars.

Family Simulation: Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn (MCAR) enables marriage, children, and betrayal mechanics.

Visual Depth: SkinLayers3D and Oculus (with Proxima Shaders) enhance realism and shader compatibility.

Survival Enhancements: AppleSkin for hunger visualization, Lithosphere for terrain realism.
